title: The Inside Story of ChatGPT’s Astonishing Potential | Greg Brockman | TED
summary: OpenAI cofounder Greg Brockman explains the design principles behind ChatGPT and demos unreleased plug-ins at TED 2023. In the follow-up, TED head Chris Anderson presses him on the timeline of development and the risks of releasing such a tool.
why: HN commenters cite it as a primary source for Brockman's views, such as moving fast to reduce risk, and for capability anecdotes like GPT-4's arithmetic.
